Components / Surfaces

List

.dr-list · --snug · components/list.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

  • 09:00 – 10:00 Operator free · Andriy M. nearby
  • 11:00 – 12:00 Operator free
  1. 1.dr-listA <ul> with no bullets, a flex column. The gap between cards is 28, 22 under 390px. The specimen is time-slot's list.
  2. 2.dr-cardEach item is a flat card. No line and no shadow between them: the gap is the separator.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: List container.

States

No state of its own: the list is a container, and only its items take focus. A card that is one link takes the card link states.

When to use

The list sets the gap between cards, and that gap is always greater than any gap inside one, so proximity groups in the right direction without a border or a shadow. 18 files stack their cards with it: 4 at the default gap and 14 snug.

The rung is chosen by what surrounds the list, not by taste. Where the list is the screen and has nothing to be confused with, 28 is right and still clears the 20 inside a card. Where it is one zone among several, main separates zones by 12, so 28 would put siblings further apart than strangers; the snug rung, 8, clusters the group and lets the zones separate. Chat messages and wallet rows are a sequence rather than a set of separate objects, so they take 8 as well, the same step that separates parts inside a card.

Each card also carries .dr-listing, as on the screens. It has no rule of its own.

The list carries no words of its own. An empty list is a message block that says why it is empty and gives one way out.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Layout (Two list rungs) · inventory.md § 1.3 (List container) · ui/kit.html List and its snug rung

Rule and anti-rule

Do

  • Olena H.· 5.0

    “Fast and careful — package arrived sealed and on time.”

    Package deliveryToday
  • Andriy P.· 4.0

    “Good shots overall, a couple came out a bit dark.”

    Photo & videoYesterday

A list that shares the screen with other zones takes --snug, so the cards read as one group and the zones above and below still separate. This is ratings, where the reviews sit under the score.

Don’t

Leave with the concierge, entrance code 4417.
Ring twice; the gate is on the courtyard side.

Cards stacked with no gap: two surfaces of one tone merge into one, and only a border or a shadow could part them, both of which the system forbids. Stack cards in a .dr-list. For facts inside one card use a row panel, which separates rows with a hairline.
